title: Rafael and the Bell
author: Marguerite Blackwood
blurb: Lior Vane, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
